title: Indlela Yokuguqula Amavidiyo Ezinkundla Zokuxhumana Abe yi-MP3
description: Guqula amavidiyo e-TikTok, Instagram, Facebook ne-X abe yi-MP3 ngaphandle kwe-app. Namathisela ilinki ku-I Need Save, ukhethe i-MP3 ye-192 kbps.
photoCaption: I-MP3 ilungele ukudlalwa kunoma iyiphi idivayisi.
photo2Caption: Khetha i-MP3 uma udinga izwi kuphela.
body:
Kwesinye isikhathi okufunayo evidiyweni akusona isithombe, kodwa yizwi layo. Kungaba ingoma yangemuva emnandi, isiqeshana se-podcast, noma intshumayelo ofuna ukuyilalela ngesikhathi ushayela. Esikhundleni sokulondoloza ividiyo yonke edla indawo yokugcina, ungaguqula amavidiyo ezinkundla zokuxhumana abe yi-MP3 ngqo ku-browser nge-I Need Save. Ngaphandle kwe-app eyengeziwe, ngaphandle kokungena ngemvume, futhi mahhala.

Kungani Ulondoloza Njengomsindo?

Kunezizathu ezimbalwa ezenza ifomethi yomsindo ivame ukuba lula:

  • Amafayela amancane. Amafayela omsindo alula kakhulu kunamavidiyo, ngakho indawo yokugcina yefoni yakho ihlala isikhathi eside.
  • Adlala noma kuphi. I-MP3 iyaziwa cishe yizo zonke izidlali zomculo, efonini nakukhompyutha.
  • Kumnandi ukulalela. Ungalalela ngenkathi wenza okunye ngaphandle kokubuka isikrini.

Yiziphi Izinkundla Ongathatha Umsindo Wazo?

I-I Need Save isebenza nokuthunyelwe okusesidlangalaleni okuvela ezinkundleni eziningi, kuhlanganise i-TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), Pinterest, Snapchat Spotlight, Tumblr, LinkedIn, Bluesky, iziqeshana ze-Twitch, SoundCloud, Dailymotion, Imgur, 9GAG, ne-Streamable. Ku-Instagram, khumbula ukuthi le nkundla kwesinye isikhathi ivimba izicelo noma idinga ukungena ngemvume.

Njengesiqaphelo, i-YouTube, Reddit, ne-Vimeo okwamanje azisekelwa ngoba lezo zinkundla zivimba iseva.

Indlela Yokuguqula Ividiyo Ibe yi-MP3 Isinyathelo Ngesinyathelo

Indlela iyafana kuzo zonke izinkundla ezisekelwayo:

  1. Vula i-app yezokuxhumana bese ufuna ividiyo ofuna ukulondoloza umsindo wayo.
  2. Thepha inkinobho ethi Yabelana (Share), bese ukhetha Kopisha ilinki (Copy link).
  3. Vula i-browser bese uvakashela i-ineedsave.com.
  4. Namathisela ilinki ebhokisini elikhona, noma uthephe inkinobho ethi Namathisela.
  5. Cindezela okuthi Landa bese ulinda kuze kuvele uhlu lwezinketho.
  6. Engxenyeni ethi Umsindo, khetha i-MP3 ye-192 kbps noma umsindo wekhwalithi yangempela.
  7. Linda kancane. Uma inkinobho ibonisa okuthi Iyalungisa…, ifayela liyacutshungulwa futhi ukulanda kuzoqala ngokuzenzakalelayo uma selilungile.

Kuqediwe! Ifayela lomsindo manje selilondoloziwe kudivayisi yakho.

Umsindo Wangempela Noma i-MP3 ye-192 kbps: Yikuphi Okufanele Ukukhethe?

Engxenyeni ethi Umsindo kuvamise ukuba nezinhlobo ezimbili zezinketho. Ngayinye inezinzuzo zayo.

Umsindo wekhwalithi yangempela

Lona umsindo njengoba unikezwe yinkundla, ngaphandle kokuguqulwa kabusha. Khetha le nketho uma ufuna ikhwalithi yezwi ihlale injengoba injalo ekuqaleni.

I-MP3 ye-192 kbps

Le nketho iwumphumela wokuguqula ividiyo ibe yifomethi ye-MP3 ene-bitrate engu-192 kbps. Inzuzo yayo ikukusebenza yonke indawo: i-MP3 idlala cishe kuwo wonke amadivayisi nama-app omculo, kuhlanganise nezidlali ezindala ezimotweni noma izipikha.

Ithiphu: Uma ungabaza, khetha i-MP3 ye-192 kbps. Ikhwalithi yayo imnandi ukulalelwa emculweni nasezingxoxweni, futhi iyifomethi elula kakhulu ukudlalwa noma kuphi.

Imibono Yokusebenzisa Amafayela e-MP3

Uma usunefayela lomsindo, kunezindlela eziningi zokulijabulela:

  • Lalela ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Lidlale lapho uhamba noma endaweni enesignali ebuthakathaka ngaphandle kokuqeda idatha.
  • Funda ngenkathi wenza okunye. Londoloza iziqeshana zezifundo, izingxoxo, noma amathiphu owathole ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, bese uwalalela ngenkathi upheka noma uzivocavoca.
  • Ingobo yomlando yakho. Londoloza amazwi akhumbulekayo, isibonelo imiyalezo yomndeni eyabiwe ku-akhawunti esesidlangalaleni.

Ngoba amafayela mancane, ungalondoloza amafayela omsindo amaningi ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuthi indawo yokugcina izogcwala ngokushesha.

Amafayela e-MP3 Alondolozwa Kuphi?

  • I-Android nekhompyutha: ifayela lingena kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe). Ungalivula nge-app yokuphatha amafayela noma isidlali somculo.
  • I-iPhone/iPad (Safari): ifayela lingena ku-app ethi Files, kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe). Ukusuka lapho ungalidlala ngqo.

Udinga umhlahlandlela oningiliziwe mayelana nendawo yamafayela? Funda indatshana ethi amafayela alandiwe alondolozwa kuphi.

Amafayela adluliswa ngqo esuka enkundleni yangempela aye kudivayisi yakho futhi awagcinwa kuseva ye-I Need Save.

Uma Inketho Yomsindo Ingaveli Noma Yehluleka

Ezinye izimo zenza umsindo ungakwazi ukuthathwa:

  • Ividiyo ivela ku-akhawunti eyimfihlo.
  • Okuqukethwe kubonakala kuphela ngemuva kokungena ngemvume.
  • Okuqukethwe kukhawulelwe ezifundeni ezithile.
  • Ilinki ivela enkundleni engakasekelwa.

Zama ukukopisha futhi ilinki ngqo enkinobhweni ethi Yabelana, bese uphinda inqubo.

Hlonipha Amalungelo Obunikazi Bomculo

Izingoma nokuqoshwa kwamazwi kuvikelwe ngamalungelo obunikazi. Sebenzisa amafayela omsindo owalandile ukuze uwalalele wena kuphela. Uma ufuna ukuwasebenzisa futhi kokunye okuqukethwe, cela imvume kumnikazi futhi ubalule igama lakhe ngokucacile.

Imibuzo Evame Ukubuzwa

Ngidinga i-app yokuguqula?

Cha. Ukuguqulela ku-MP3 kwenziwa ngqo nge-I Need Save, ngakho udinga i-browser kuphela.

Ngingathatha umsindo kuvidiyo ye-TikTok?

Yebo. Izinyathelo ziyafana, vele ukhethe inketho ethi Umsindo ngemuva kokucindezela okuthi Landa. Uma ufuna nokulondoloza ividiyo, bheka indlela yokulanda amavidiyo e-TikTok ngaphandle kwe-watermark.

I-MP3 ephumayo inekhwalithi engakanani?

Amafayela e-MP3 aguqulwa nge-bitrate engu-192 kbps. Uma ufuna umsindo ongaguqulwanga, khetha umsindo wekhwalithi yangempela.
